name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: PMAY-Urban is a flagship mission to provide affordable housing to urban poor. The scheme offers interest subsidy on home loans, direct assistance for house construction, and affordable housing in partnership with private developers. Target is to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to all eligible families.

custom_criteria.house_ownership: No pucca house in name of any family member
custom_criteria.previous_subsidy: Should not have availed central assistance under any housing scheme

benefits.description: Credit Linked Subsidy: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loans. Subsidy rates: EWS/LIG: 6.5% on loans up to ₹6 lakh, MIG-I: 4% on loans up to ₹9 lakh, MIG-II: 3% on loans up to ₹12 lakh. Direct assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for EWS beneficiaries

documents_required.name: Income Certificate
documents_required.description: Annual income certificate from competent authority

documents_required.name: Residence Proof
documents_required.description: Proof of residence in urban area

steps: Select applicable component (CLSS, In-situ, AHP, BLC)
Submit application and note application ID
For loan subsidy: Apply through lending institution
